Data:Incident.retire.numa.json.label: An Ending, and a Consultation
Data:Incident.retire.numa.json.startdescription:
'The stars move still; time runs; the clock will strike.' - Marlowe

 [This Incident has seen its full complement of visitors, and is concluded. This Numa there will be no Incident; Numatic Visitors will seek a general consultation.]

Data:Incident.revolution.json.label: The Affair of the Threshold Revolution
Data:Incident.revolution.json.desc: In the drier reaches of the Bounds, the Légion du Seuil keeps a brutal peace. Perhaps even a necessary one. But the Légion recruits from among the Bounds-beasts. How trustworthy is it, really?  [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=edge> or <sprite name=grail> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]

Data:Incident.rising.json.label: The Affair of the Rising While
Data:Incident.rising.json.desc: Across the inner sea, across the desert sands, someone styling herself the Oracle of the Rising While has set up a tent-town where she preaches 'the truth of nearly now' to her followers. This would be of no obvious interest to the students of the invisible arts... except that although she has pitched her tents in the shadow of the Temple of Seven Coils, nothing appears to have eaten anyone. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=moon> or <sprite name=scale> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]

Data:Incident.rite.awakening.json.label: The Affair of the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Incident.rite.awakening.json.desc: An odd little image in a church in Strasbourg has become a locus for wild claims of healing and haunting. When it comes to the attention of the Church hierarchy, they'll rule it miraculous or heretical… unless someone takes a hand before then. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=nectar> or <sprite name=scale> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]

Data:Incident.rite.renewal.json.label: The Affair of the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Incident.rite.renewal.json.desc: A tapestry has been stolen from the Haustorium that depicts details of a very old rite indeed - one that may only be performed at Gladwyn Lake 'when the moon is ripe'. Exactly what it might renew is unclear, but almost inevitably someone will try it anyway. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=moon> or <sprite name=nectar> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]

Data:Incident.setup.json.label: Current Affairs
Data:Incident.setup.json.startdescription:
What's happening in the world beyond Brancrug? What visitors will the season bring?

 [We'll either draw a new Incident; find a suitable Visitor for the current Incident; or retire the current Incident if there are no visitors left for it.]
Data:Incident.setup.json.comments: This warmup just prevents the incident from firing at the same time as season-beginning events..

Data:Incident.setup.numa.json.label: River, Wheel, Flame
Data:Incident.setup.numa.json.startdescription: Time. It has been called a wheel, but my family perceive it as a flame: coolest at its heart, but wildest at its edge...[We'll draw a Numa Incident; find a suitable Visitor for the current Numa Incident; or retire the current Numa Incident if there are no visitors left for it.]

Data:Incident.stalk.json.label: The Affair of the Absent Friend
Data:Incident.stalk.json.desc: The Ligeian Medusa is long dead, as is well attested. It's nevertheless well-attested also that she walks the streets of Budapest by moonlight. That's just one of those things. But now, for the first time, she's being glimpsed in daylight too. What could that portend? [Visitors with an interest in or Mysteries will want to talk about this.]

Data:Incident.wound.json.label: The Affair of the Open Reverend
Data:Incident.wound.json.desc: In a highly specialised clinic in an obscure corner of the capital, specialists study the ecstatic agonies of the case known only as'the Open Reverend', who once was the vicar of the parish of St Agnes Forestreet. The blessings of St Agnes of the Fires and St Agnes of the Shears are ungentle. But St Agnes of the Threshold may be her cruellest aspect...  [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=heart> or <sprite name=winter> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]

Data:Inert.json.label: Inert
Data:Inert.json.desc: A device; but not one that can be activated by casual handling. [This can survive Consider without being used up, although it'll still be used up in crafting.]

Data:Infinitereadable.json.label: Multitudinuous
Data:Infinitereadable.json.desc: [There are multiple versions of this book, each individually readable; you'll start finding them once you've exhausted all other possibilities from a particular source.]

Data:Ingredient.json.label: Cooking Ingredient
Data:Ingredient.json.desc: This will be part of something greater. [When you have HOUSE OF LIGHT, Cooking Ingredients can be used for cooking and making food in the kitchen.]

Data:Inkling.json.label: Inkling
Data:Inkling.json.desc: An opportunity to gain a powerful Memory; or a precursor to the possible misuse of a Great Ink. [Complete a Further Story in a significant way - generally, this means not Concluding inconclusively - to gain an Inkling. Consider an Inkling to gain a Memory; consider two Inklings together to gain an Avenue of Enquiry.]

Data:Interest.edge.json.label: Interested in Edge
Data:Interest.edge.json.desc: Someone is interested in violence. [Edge is the principle of battle and of struggle.]

Data:Interest.forge.json.label: Interested in Forge
Data:Interest.forge.json.desc: Someone is interested in the shaping arts. [The principle of the Forge transforms and destroys.]

Data:Interest.grail.json.label: Interested in Grail
Data:Interest.grail.json.desc: Someone is interested in appetites. [The principle of the Grail honours both the birth and the feast.]
